### Measure the four native cardinal variants

Each terminated Port retains its fixed intrinsic marker, load and return.
The recipe selects one of 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees, then translates that
complete body to its authored position. It does not independently bend the
load or infer a circuit attachment from a label.

```{python}
#| id: ch6-set-axes-and-port-poses
# These are the four explicitly authored native cardinal variants in the
# course recipe. Inspect their actual measured anchors without changing loads.
for ref, pose in four_arm_layout.root.ports.items():
    fragment = four_arm_preparation.native[ref, pose.rotation]
    display({"port": ref.key, "pose": pose, "contacts": fragment.contacts})
```

This lesson inspects four explicitly chosen poses. No orientation search or
automatic completion is performed.
